Effective Climate Action Requires Capable States

Nov 13, 2026

Mariana Mazzucato

With delegations from around the world gathering for another international climate conference, the question today is not whether governments should do more to address the climate crisis, but whether they even have the capabilities to do so. After 40 years of free-market orthodoxy, many simply do not.

LONDON—The United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP31) in Antalya, Turkey, is now underway. With “Driving Implementation through Cooperation and Collective Action” as the conference’s official theme, delegates will face a familiar challenge: turning long-standing climate commitments into tangible results.
